description: This file defines the class BiometricAuthenticator, which provides a wrapper around Android's BiometricPrompt APIs to facilitate biometric authentication in an Android app. It includes methods to check biometric availability and to prompt the user for biometric authentication, handling success, failure, and error cases.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages biometric authentication prompts, checking availability and handling user authentication for biometric authentication with fallback options.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator.Availability
classes.description: Sealed class representing the availability status of biometric authentication on the device.

methods.name: availability
methods.description: Checks if biometric authentication or device credential is available and returns an Availability status.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Displays the biometric authentication prompt to the user with specified title and subtitle, and handles the callbacks for success, failure, and error.
